title: Bee Removal in Hicksville, Long Island
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Hicksville, Long Island. Licensed technicians treat and remove nests from walls, attics, eaves. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Dealing with a stinging insect nest in Hicksville? The Best Pest Control NYC provides expert wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee removal services throughout this vibrant Long Island community. Our licensed technicians treat and remove nests from residential and commercial properties — wall voids, soffits, attics, eaves, and structural wood — protecting your family and property from aggressive defenders and structural damage.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has been serving Hicksville homeowners and businesses for years with fast, reliable bee removal services. Our experienced team uses humane removal methods and offers competitive pricing from $350-$550, with same-day emergency service available throughout Nassau County.
localContext: Hicksville's mix of suburban homes, the bustling Broadway Mall area, and tree-lined neighborhoods near Cantiague Park creates ideal nesting conditions for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets in attics, wall voids, soffits, and eaves. Carpenter bees target the exposed wood trim common in post-war Cape Cods and newer developments. Our technicians are familiar with the unique construction styles of Hicksville properties, ensuring thorough nest location, treatment, and entry-point sealing to prevent recolonization.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Hicksville?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my Hicksville property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and emergency service throughout Hicksville and surrounding Long Island areas. Most nest treatment and removal jobs are completed within 2–4 hours, though nests deep inside wall voids or difficult-to-access locations may require additional time for proper treatment and sealing.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Hicksville?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Will wasps or hornets return after nest removal in Hicksville?
faqs.answer: Our service includes nest treatment, removal of accessible nest material, and sealing every entry point to prevent recolonization by the same species. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
